About

Software made to be owned, not rented

Plenivostudio is a small, independent software maker. We build digital planning tools as files you buy once and keep — no subscriptions, no accounts, no cloud services standing between you and your plans.

Our first product, the Ultimate Offline Life Planner, is a single self-contained HTML file. It runs in your browser, works without an internet connection, and stores your data locally on your own device. When you are done planning, you can export everything to a file you control.

What we believe

  • Ownership over access. When you pay for software, you should own a copy of it — not rent permission to use it.
  • Privacy by architecture. The simplest way to protect your data is to never collect it. Our planner has no analytics, no tracking and no network calls.
  • Honesty over marketing. We state what our software does, what it requires, and where its limits are — on this site and in the documentation included with every product.
